|game_text='''0 side — Local Uprising'''

Deploy Hoth system and [Virtual Block 6] [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V) (Virtual Block 6){{!}}Main Power Generators]]. May deploy [[Echo Base Garrison]] and/or [[Maneuvering Flaps (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Maneuvering Flaps]]. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [[Hoth Sentry]] or non-Hoth locations (except [[Rendezvous Point]]). [[T-47 Battle Formation]] is an Out Of Play Interrupt and [Immune to Sense]. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may ▼ an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth. Flip this card during your move phase if you control three exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. Place out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'

'''7 side — Liberation'''

While this side up, Wedge may not cancel battle destiny draws on Hoth. During your control phase: opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground marker site you control with both a T-47 and a Rebel, and you may use two Force to ▲ any one card. Whenever you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage, or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of Hoth locations you occupy. Flip this card if you do not control 2 exterior Hoth sites. Place out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'

The PC-E1 text of the 0 side is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Local Uprising / Liberation (V) (Errata)]].

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Local Uprising / Liberation (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “is an Out Of Play Interrupt and” to “may only be played once per game and is” on the 0 side (slip marked E): “Deploy Hoth system and [Virtual Block 6] Main Power Generators. May deploy Echo Base Garrison and/or Maneuvering Flaps. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Hoth Sentry or non-Hoth locations (except Rendezvous Point). T-47 Battle Formation may only be played once per game and is [Immune to Sense]. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may ▼ an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth. Flip this card during your move phase if you control three exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. Place out of play if Main Power Generators ‘blown away.’” The 7 side is unchanged.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=47, page 47. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=47 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee announced this 0 side text on 19 November 2012, effective immediately, the day it removed the Out Of Play Interrupt subtype from the game<ref name="pcforum-p768283">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 19 November 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p768283 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
